sources.title: Haven-AI-Companion · GitHub
sources.snippet: Haven is a fully self-hosted, offline-first, private AI companion and smart assistant ecosystem. Designed to give users absolute ownership over their data, models, and interactions, Haven replaces cloud-dependent subscriptions with low-latency local orchestration.

sources.title: GitHub - amarisaster/Haven: Self-hosted AI companion chat. Fork, deploy ...
sources.snippet: Haven is a self-hosted companion chat app. You bring the AI model, you bring the personality, and Haven gives them a place to live — with real conversations, identity persistence, and a voice that sounds like them.
